headline: BOMB DEFUSE — the bomb finally breaks
lede: The boom used to lose its lid; now it loses its body. Steel plate chunks tear from the real chassis rect, fly radially off the blast centre, fall like heavier metal and bounce off the deck with damped skids — pure paint physics, the hash never noticed.

notes.text: Chunk-of-bomb physics (#2357, PR #2361): 4 riveted chassis-plate chunks (16–38 px, clearly heavier than the spark dots) spawn from the chassis geometry itself — now single-sourced so view and gates can't drift — get a radial outward kick, gravity 0.32/frame, two damped deck bounces (0.45 restitution) with friction skid, then settle and fade where they land.

Proven to fail: zeroing gravity reddens the fall pin; refusing the bounce or the spawn reddens the live drive gates (chunks=0, bounced=0). defusecheck 300/300 (+10 pins), defusedrive 41/41 with a real ground bounce observed mid-flight, zero page errors.

Ladder hygiene (#2354–#2356): SHORT ORDER SHOUT, GRAVEL YARD and TALK ME DOWN came up weakestStage, but their open gaps are deferred full-duplex infra, d-pad/no-second-pad law conflicts, structural non-gaps and shipped-history bullets — each owned with an audit note so future picks aim at shippable work.

#1711 re-audited at claim time and released with evidence: store still carries the same 7 graded takes (newest 11-14), /status writeKey:false, jonq #2305 AWAITING — the remainder stays Jon-side (phone clap-test + wrangler secret).
